question: six bells commence tolling together at 7 ∶ 59 am. They toll at intervals of 3, 6, 9, 12 and 15 seconds respectively. How many time will they toll together till 8 ∶ 16 am? (excluding the toll at 7 ∶ 59 am)
solution:
**Given:**

Six bells commence tolling together at 7 ∶ 59 am 

Toll intervals of 3, 6, 9, 12, and 15 seconds respectively.

**Concept used:**

Least Common Multiple (LCM) 

**Calculation:**

A least common multiple of (3, 6, 9, 12, and 15) = 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 × 5 = 180 sec

Bells ring together after every 180 sec

Required number of times in 17 minutes (17 × 60 seconds)

⇒Number of times they toll together = ((17 × 60))/(180)

⇒ Number of times they toll together = (1020)/(180) = 5.7 ~ 5

This is approximated as 5 bells will not ring in fractions and, it will take some more time to bell 6th ring. 

**∴ They toll together 5 times in 17 minutes.**

9
